   non-loopback host is refused before sending.

verdicts.item:
5. A09-2, A09-3: A redirect to another host is not followed and a production `http` target on a
   non-loopback host is refused before sending.
   [witness: verification:kernel_a09_no_redirect_plain_http_restricted]
statements: A09-3: http_without_tls -> instance.class IN {local_dev, disposable_rig} OR loopback(host)
verdicts.why: The check verifies that the cross-host redirect reaches only the origin and is classified as not followed. It also verifies that production HTTP on a non-loopback host fails with `plain_http_not_allowed` and creates no send attempt.
